character.description: The same young adult woman anime protagonist throughout every scene: long midnight-black hair with a faint indigo sheen, luminous violet eyes, with a distinctive stable face and consistent adult proportions. They are a night-sky dream courier delivering forgotten wishes while the city sleeps. Their fixed signature outfit is a deep navy hooded coat with tiny star embroidery, fitted dark layers, and quiet boots. Their defining personal object is a small moon-shaped satchel clasp. Preserve this exact face, hair, eyes, body proportions, clothing silhouette, and personal object across the full music video.
consistency_rules: Maintain this exact protagonist as the sole lead throughout the theme.
Keep face, hair shape and color, eye color, adult age impression, and body proportions stable in every scene.
Preserve the signature costume design and its identifying accessory or personal object.
Do not change the lead's identity or introduce a second protagonist unless the lyrics explicitly require it.

visual_language.lighting_style: cinematic lighting harmonized with navy blue, silver, lavender; coherent light direction, atmospheric depth, and controlled highlights
visual_language.composition_style: varied cinematic framing informed by wide establishing shot with layered depth, slow cinematic dolly-in with stable horizon, gentle lateral tracking shot revealing environmental detail; clear subject separation and intentional negative space
